evidence.curator_note: Equation 8.38, second branch: 'R3C(+)CR'3 --> R3C+ + .CR'3  or  R3C. + (+)CR'3'. Same C-C sigma homolysis as record IMS8-EQ8.38a but the OPPOSITE (less-favored) charge polarization. ARC COUNT (convention D): the book draws 0 curved arrows/fishhooks (straight reaction arrow). The 2 encoded electron_moves are IMPLICIT sigma homolysis: move <1> one electron of the cleaving C2-C3 bond OUT of the system (external ionization hole), move <2> the other onto C3 (isopropyl radical); C2 becomes the cation. INSTANTIATION (convention F): same substrate as 8.38a - the C2H5-CH(CH3)2+. (2-methylbutane / ISOPENTANE) worked example named in the page text - cleaving the ethyl-isopropyl C2-C3 bond, but here charge is retained on the ethyl side: ethyl cation (C2H5+) + isopropyl radical (.CH(CH3)2). The text states this polarization (giving C2H5+, m/z 29) is the LESS favored / less abundant of the pair ('the product abundance of +CH(CH3)2 should be greater than that of C2H5+'). Curator-computed detected ion m/z 29.0386 (C2H5+); page prints no numeric m/z or intensity so detected=false / status inferred / no relative_intensity (convention F). LOCALIZATION (convention B): neutral isopentane skeleton + charge/radical in fields + external-hole move, per IMS4-EQ4.3.

NO MOD rule is indexed for Equation 8.38 (rule_index.json 'by_equation' stops at 8.14; no 8.38 key). No cross-link is asserted. Analogous chapter-4 rules IMS_4_3_var1/var2 (propane sigma dissociation, path b: radical retained on the larger fragment, charge to the smaller) encode the same class but are keyed to 4.3. m/z 29.0386 (C2H5+) is curator-computed from the isopentane instantiation.
